title: Baseball
description: Test your knowledge of America's pastime!

questions.question: How many innings are in a standard MLB game?
questions.explanation: A standard MLB game is 9 innings, with extra innings if tied.

questions.question: Who holds the MLB record for most career home runs?
questions.explanation: Barry Bonds holds the record with 762 career home runs.

questions.question: Three strikes make an out.
questions.explanation: A batter is out after three strikes.

questions.question: Which team has won the most World Series titles?
questions.explanation: The Yankees have 27 World Series championships, far more than any other team.

questions.question: What is the distance between bases on an MLB field?
questions.explanation: The bases are 90 feet apart on a standard MLB diamond.

questions.question: Jackie Robinson broke baseball's color barrier in 1947.
questions.explanation: Jackie Robinson debuted for the Brooklyn Dodgers on April 15, 1947, breaking the MLB color barrier.

questions.question: Which position wears protective gear behind home plate?
questions.explanation: The catcher receives pitches and wears a mask, chest protector, and shin guards.

questions.question: What is a 'no-hitter'?

options.text: A game with no runs scored
A game in which a pitcher allows no hits
A game where no one strikes out

questions.explanation: A no-hitter is when a pitcher (or pitchers) complete a game without giving up a single hit.

questions.question: Who is known as 'The Sultan of Swat'?
questions.explanation: Babe Ruth earned the nickname 'The Sultan of Swat' for his prolific home run hitting.

questions.question: A perfect game means no batter from the opposing team reaches base.
questions.explanation: A perfect game retires all 27 batters in order — no hits, walks, errors, or hit batsmen.
